---
title: "About Me"
---

## Background
I grew up in Harare, Zimbabwe, where I developed an early interest in mathematics. I went on to complete a BSc in Applied Mathematics before moving to South Africa to pursue an MSc in Mathematics.

## Why Data Science
My time studying mathematics sharpened my appetite for advanced analytics, and I found myself drawn to the practical, data-driven problem solving that data science offers. The MDS program felt like the natural next step to build on that foundation and turn theoretical knowledge into applied skill.

## Outside of Data Science
I'm a recreational golfer, and I've come to appreciate the character building that comes with a high handicap. I'm also a passionate football fan and support Chelsea FC, and I follow Formula 1 closely, cheering on Scuderia Ferrari.
